Welcome To Castle Dargan Estate
Nestled in the heart of Sligo’s breath taking countryside, Castle Dargan Estate is a luxurious retreat offering an unforgettable escape.
Set on 170 acres of rolling parkland, our estate combines historic charm with modern elegance, featuring a championship golf course, a tranquil spa, and stylish accommodations.
Whether you re seeking a romantic getaway, a dream wedding venue, or an idyllic golf experience, Castle Dargan Estate provides the perfect setting. Indulge in dining, unwind in the spa, or explore the natural beauty of the Wild Atlantic Way—all from the comfort of our enchanting estate.
The great poet, W.B. Yeats, was inspired to write of its charms in The King of The Great Clock Tower and more than a hundred years later we invite you to be enchanted by the timeless elegance and unique atmosphere that will stay with you forever.
O, but I saw a solemn light; Said the rambling, shambling travelling man; Castle Dargan’s ruin all lit’ Lovely ladies dancing in it
W. B. Yeats
ABOUT US
Packages & Special Offers
Summer Breaks
Soak up the sunshine and unwind in luxury this summer at Castle Dargan Estate. Whether it s a
relaxing getaway or an adventurous break in Sligo, we have the perfect package waiting for you.
Availability is limited, so plan your unforgettable escape today
Book Now!
Stay & Play Golf
Enjoy a two-night getaway, waking up to a hearty full Irish breakfast & Tee off on our stunning 18-hole Championship Golf Course. In the evening, unwind with a delicious three-course dinner in Middleton Bar, perfectly paired with a complimentary bottle of wine.
Book Now!
Spa Packages
Discover the perfect overnight spa escape with luxury accommodation, breakfast, access to our Thermal Relaxation Suite and indulgent spa treatments. Whether you re planning a girls getaway, a midweek retreat, or a relaxing wellness break, our spa packages offer the ideal opportunity to unwind and recharge.
Book Now!
Dining Breaks
Relax and unwind book your dining packages here at Castle Dargan Estate. Our dining
packages give you the perfect opportunity to take a break from the hustle and bustle of daily life
and enjoy the stunning scenery and all that Castle Dargan has to offer.
Book Now!
Weddings at Castle Dargan Estate
Steeped in romantic history, the beautiful Castle Dargan Estate will capture your heart…
Nestled in the heart of Yeats’ Country , Castle Dargan Estate is a wedding venue like no other. Spanning 170 acres of rolling parkland and ancient woodland , our estate offers a breathtaking backdrop of freshwater brooks, historic stone walls, and the enchanting ruins of Castle Dargan itself . The natural beauty of Sligo’s countryside blends effortlessly with the charm of our elegant venue, creating an atmosphere of timeless romance.
At Castle Dargan Estate, we understand that your wedding day is one of the most important moments of your life. That’s why we offer fully customizable packages , ensuring that every detail is tailored to reflect your unique love story. Whether you dream of an intimate gathering or a grand celebration , our dedicated and experienced wedding team will be by your side, bringing your vision to life with care, creativity, and precision.
Indulge in a culinary experience to remember , as our Head Chef and expert kitchen team craft a mouthwatering menu using the finest locally sourced ingredients . Enjoy exquisite flavors while overlooking the picturesque Castle Dargan Golf Course , where rolling greens meet the beauty of the Sligo landscape.
With our warm hospitality, stunning surroundings, and unwavering attention to detail, Castle Dargan Estate promises to make your wedding day truly unforgettable —a magical beginning to your happily ever after.
More Information
Dining at Castle Dargan Estate
At Castle Dargan Estate, we are committed to delivering an exceptional dining experience , where every dish is crafted with passion, precision, and the finest locally sourced ingredients.
Our Head Chef and his talented culinary team have carefully curated a menu that caters to every occasion, blending traditional flavors with modern creativity to ensure an unforgettable meal. From light bites to indulgent feasts, each dish is prepared with the highest standards of quality and care.
Whether you re in the mood for relaxed, casual dining in the welcoming atmosphere of Middleton Bar , a delightful Afternoon Tea experience in the elegant Coach House Lounge , or a private dining celebration for a special family occasion, Castle Dargan Estate provides the perfect setting. Our warm hospitality, stunning surroundings , and expertly crafted menus make every meal a moment to savour.
We invite you to sit back, relax, and indulge in the flavours of Castle Dargan Estate, where great food and great company come together in an unforgettable culinary journey .

History of Castle Dargan Estate
Castle Dargan Estate is nestled on 170 acres of mature woodlands with breath-taking views.
The Estate first opened its doors in August 2006 and has steadily grown in popularity since then. The centerpiece of the Estate is the Castle Dargan House. Built in the 18th century, its 21st century restoration has rekindled the country lifestyle of its early years.
The Ruins of the Original Castle Dargan are still visible to this day on our Golf Course. You can find these located beside our 3rd Hole on our 18 Hole Championship Golf Course.
These Ruins bear witness to the wonderful sense of history that still exists in what is now a rare retreat for the discerning traveller.
W.B Yeats himself was a frequent visitor of the Estate, and wrote about the Castle Ruins in his famous poem The Wicked Hawthorn Tree
“O, but I saw a solemn light; Said the rambling, shambling travelling man; Castle Dargan’s ruin all lit’ Lovely ladies dancing in it” – W. B. Yeats
The castle is divided into two sections that are 25m apart. The eastern section on the right is most likely the remains of the tower house s main tower. The ruins are in the south east corner of the tower, and there are only two storeys left, but it would have been higher.
A portion of a doorway survives, providing access to a stairwell lit by a series of slit windows. These lead to a shattered entrance to a first-floor chamber. The remains of an angled passageway and doorway can be found on the ground level. This castle fragment was most likely a mural tower connected to the bawn wall.
Between the east and west blocks, there is a curving section of a natural rock outcrop with partial stone-facing arcs, which is most likely the remains of the bawn wall. The remains of a number of 18th / 19th-century buildings and a walled garden, which were part of the estate of the 18th century Castle, can be found just to the south of the Castle Dargan House.
William Middleton
In March 1875, William Middleton paid £12,000 for Castle Dargan with a five-year £10,000 loan from Andrew Hosie, a successful miller in Dromahair. William Middleton died in 1882, the loan remaining unpaid, and John Robert Ormsby departing unexpectedly and alone for the United States.
In September 1883, the 959 acres of Castle Dargan were auctioned off, with Andrew Hosie being the sole bidder, and Mary Ormsby (William Middleton’s daughter) and her seven children retiring to Elsinore, a Middleton property in Rosses Point.
One of the daughters, Amy Frances Vernon, later achieved fame as a County Sligo lady golfer, winning Irish and South African Ladies Championships; her husband, Larry (Arthur) Vernon, won the inaugural West of Ireland Championship at County Sligo Golf Club in 1923.
Andrew Hosie died in 1888, having already vested Castle Dargan in his nephew, John, in December 1883.
Following extensive repairs to the house in 1884, the current hall-door entrance and bay windows were added in 1895. The demesne was farmed by John’s son, James, and grandson, John, until the death of John C. Hosie in November 1997.
With the sale of the mountain lands in 1894 to the Coopers of Markree Castle, the remaining 145 acres of Castle Dargan were sold in 1998 by Mrs Kathleen Hosie to Dermot Fallon of Ballinacarrow, Co. Sligo.
With that, the continuous occupation of three families over almost six centuries was finally drawn to a close.

Executive Rooms
The Magnificent Castle Dargan House was built in the second half of the eighteenth century and was home to The Ormsby Family.
It is now comprised of four superbly appointed Suites, each named after W.B Yeats poetry, offering a unique and romantic getaway in the beautiful County Sligo.
Book Now
Every suite has been beautifully decorated effortlessly combining the elegant charm of the Edwardian era with genuine antique furniture and paintings with the first-class comforts of modern living.
Castle Dargan House Suites have all the amenities you would expect from a four-star property, with the added luxury of a Nespresso Machine for your morning coffee.
Book Now
Rewind & Relax
Deluxe Rooms
Settle in and take in the beauty of the Irish country and the rolling hills of County Sligo.
The Estate’s modern wing is home to two floors of deluxe hotel rooms. Large windows look out on the stunning estate grounds.. Appointed with stylish furniture and decorated in a modern style.
Book Now

FAQ - Castle Dargan
Skip to main content
Hit enter to search or ESC to close
Close Search
FAQ
General Questions
How far is Castle Dargan Estate from Sligo Town?
Sligo Town is a 10-minute drive from Castle Dargan Estate.
How far is Castle Dargan Estate from the airport?
Knock Airport is a 43 minute drive from Castle Dargan Estate (47 km).
Dublin Airport is a 2.5 hour drive from Castle Dargan Estate (207 km).
Shannon Airport is 2.5 hour dive from Castle Dargan Estate (200km).
Is Castle Dargan Estate wheelchair-friendly?
Yes, the hotel is wheelchair-friendly.
We have specific rooms that we can allocate for wheelchair users.
Are there onsite parking facilities?
Yes, there is onsite parking facilities at Castle Dargan Estate.
What time is room check-in?
Room check-in is at 3pm.
What time is room check out?
Room check out is at 12pm.
Is there a swimming pool on-site?
Unfortunately there is no swimming pool on-site.
There is a golf course, driving range and spa here at the hotel.
Are pets welcome in the hotel?
Unfortunately the hotel is not pet friendly.
Are there clubs available for the driving range?
Yes, you can get the clubs at the golf shop.
All equipment hire can be got at the golf shop.
If I am staying in the hotel, can I use the Icon Spa?
Facilities are for the use of guests with booked treatments.
We do advise booking appointments to avoid disappointment.
